int_name: N BROAD ST & W HUNTING PARK AVE

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban arterial intersection with a high-visibility continental crosswalk and curb ramps. However, the long crossing distance across at least four lanes of traffic without a median refuge increases pedestrian exposure and risk.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, significantly increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Multiple Threat Potential
hazards.description: The multi-lane configuration allows for situations where one vehicle stops for a pedestrian while another in an adjacent lane does not, creating a high-risk collision scenario.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the width of the roadway

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide, multi-lane arterial intersection with marked zebra crosswalks and overhead traffic signals. While sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the environment is dominated by vehicle travel lanes, resulting in a long, unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must traverse at least five lanes of traffic, increasing exposure time to vehicles.

hazards.name: Lack of Physical Refuge
hazards.description: The center of the roadway lacks a raised median or refuge island, leaving pedestrians vulnerable in the middle of the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway marked with temporary cones

hazards.name: Sight Line Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles and large trucks near the intersection corners can block the visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a permanent raised concrete refuge island in the center of the roadway to allow for two-stage crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sight lines.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light.
